scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-prime and arbitrary-dimension claim is proved analytically by affine-span reduction, the prime cyclic Fourier-minor theorem in dimension one, and a direct unit-circle intersection argument in dimension two. Exact finite cyclotomic checks are corroborative rather than substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to exactly three nonzero coefficients on elementary Abelian groups of odd prime exponent. It does not classify larger sparse supports, composite exponents, or the characteristic-two three-point case.
title: Exact three-sparse Fourier support spectra on elementary Abelian odd-prime groups
